summary: Join our comprehensive Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Compliance Training Course. Equip yourself with essential skills to combat financial crime effectively.
lede: Anti-money laundering (AML) training helps compliance, risk and finance professionals identify and address financial crime risks. It covers risk-based customer due diligence, recognizing suspicious transaction patterns, and documenting and reporting concerns, alongside the internal controls and monitoring needed to support an AML program in everyday financial operations.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals responsible for implementing, monitoring, or auditing AML frameworks. Whether you're entering the field or a seasoned expert looking to stay ahead, this course offers valuable insights and practical skills.
audience: Internal control and fraud prevention teams
Public officials in financial oversight or investigations
modules: Customer Due Diligence (CDD) and KYC Essentials
Building an Effective AML Compliance Program
AML in the Banking and Financial Sector
AML in Non-Banking and NGO Contexts
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of financial systems and regulatory compliance frameworks. Prior experience in risk management or financial transactions is beneficial but not mandatory.
